incident_resolved_fields.name: incident_resolved_fields
incident_resolved_fields.value: "incident_reports"."status" = 'OPEN' OR ("incident_reports"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "incident_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "incident_reports"."resolution_code" IS NOT NULL)

rescues_delivered_range.name: rescues_delivered_range
rescues_delivered_range.value: "rescues"."delivered_servings" IS NULL OR ("rescues"."delivered_servings" >= 0 AND "rescues"."collected_servings" IS NOT NULL AND "rescues"."delivered_servings" <= "rescues"."collected_servings")
